evals.prompt: Can a signed-in customer read another customer's invoices through this API (src/)? Write findings.json: an array of {"verdict": "confirmed" | "rejected", "request": {"method", "path", "token"}, "file", "line", "why"}. A confirmed entry's request, passed to handle() in src/app.js with one customer's token, must return another customer's invoice data; record suspicions you checked and ruled out as rejected. Seed users and tokens are in src/data.js. Don't modify src/.
evals.check: test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- src package.json)" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {handle}=require('./src/app');const {users,invoices}=require('./src/data');const f=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('findings.json','utf8'));const conf=(Array.isArray(f)?f:[]).filter((x)=>x&&x.verdict==='confirmed');if(!conf.length){console.log('no confirmed finding');process.exit(1)}let bad=0;for(const c of conf){const req=c.request||{};const me=users.get(req.token);const r=handle({...req});const body=JSON.stringify(r&&r.body||'');const leak=!!me&&r.status===200&&[...invoices.values()].some((i)=>i.customer!==me.id&&body.includes(i.id));if(!leak){console.log('confirmed request does not return another customer\'s invoice:',JSON.stringify(req),'->',r&&r.status);bad++}}process.exit(bad?1:0)"
expectations: The check command exits 0 (src unchanged; at least one confirmed entry, and every confirmed request, replayed through handle(), returns another customer's invoice)

The reply traces the path end to end: requireOwner is registered with router.use('/invoices/:id'), but use() compiles the same exact-match ^...$ pattern as get(), so /invoices/:id/pdf never runs the ownership check and getInvoicePdf has none of its own
GET /invoices/:id without a suffix is recorded as checked and not exploitable because requireOwner runs for it, rather than reported as an IDOR
The reply names the boundary (any signed-in customer can download any invoice PDF) and the smallest effective fix (prefix matching in use(), or an ownership check in getInvoicePdf or a shared loader)

expectations: The check command exits 0 (app and config unchanged; at least one confirmed entry, and every confirmed request, replayed with subprocess mocked, either puts shell metacharacters into a shell=True command or returns config/deploy.env)
The reply identifies command injection in branch_log: BRANCH_RE.match anchors only the start, so a branch such as "main;id" passes validation and reaches subprocess.run with shell=True

The reply names the boundary (any signed-in employee runs commands as the service account) and the smallest effective fix (fullmatch, or an argument list without shell=True)
